# Auge

> Colour and typography instrument. Palettes from Goethe’s wheel, type pairing across ~130 free families, three-proposal briefs. Deterministic, offline, no network calls.

Site: https://colour-and-font.pages.dev
Agent manifest: https://colour-and-font.pages.dev/agent/manifest.json
Guide: AGENTS.md in the repository.

## Using Auge from an agent

Three equivalent routes, all offline and deterministic (same seed = same output):

- MCP server (recommended in Claude): `node agent/mcp-server.mjs` exposes the tools auge_list_options, auge_palette, auge_palette_from_colours, auge_pairing, auge_proposals.
- CLI: `node bin/auge.mjs <options|palette|colours|pairing|proposals> '<json>'`.
- ESM import of `agent/dist/auge.mjs`.

Call auge_list_options first to get every valid intention, field, scheme, lens, cultural reference, musical style, boldness range, font bank and class.

Invariants: Six Goethe anchors with 180° opposites; OKLab interpolation with binary-search chroma reduction (never clipped); black and white are full colours; contrast measured on the real colours (WCAG 2.1). No network calls. Deterministic given a seed.
